scope: Bounded offline pilot of VerifyResult signature-omitted content identity, independent signature authentication, and the PR #362 reference consumer. This is not whole-PR or whole-Standard coverage.
requirements: CORE §B.2: canonical form omits signature(s); content hash is SHA-256 of that canonical form
CORE §B.2 per-artifact template and SIG-2: reconstruct artifact hashes and signature payloads independently
DACS-2 §7.5: VerifyResult omits signature and signs ASCII dacs-verifyresult:v1: || verifyresult_hash
DACS-2 CRQ-1/§7.7.1: every committed VerifyResultRef is dereferenced and its hash, signature, recipe authority, and applicability are validated
CORE §B.2 IBH-4 retained challenge rule as exercised by the candidate PresenceEvaluationRuntime

cases.name: valid-coherent-artifact
cases.purpose: Known-good signed VerifyResult and complete downstream reference closure

cases.name: signature-only-replacement
cases.purpose: A signature-only mutation preserves content identity but loses authentication
forbiddenEffects: change content hash because signature bytes changed

cases.name: signed-content-mutation-stale-reference
cases.purpose: A coherently re-signed content mutation changes identity and a stale reference is rejected
forbiddenEffects: misclassify valid regenerated signature as the failing guard

cases.name: regenerated-reference-closure
cases.purpose: The same signed-content mutation is accepted after all signed references are regenerated coherently
forbiddenEffects: accept without composite and bundle re-signing

cases.name: object-order-and-whitespace-invariance
cases.purpose: Safe-subset independent canonicalization is invariant to member order and insignificant JSON whitespace
forbiddenEffects: change identity due to member insertion order

cases.name: wrong-recipe-authority
cases.purpose: A valid signature by an untrusted key is refused against authenticated recipe authority
forbiddenEffects: treat signer self-assertion as recipe authority

cases.name: coherent-alternate-authority-twin
cases.purpose: The EVAL-006 artifact is accepted when independent trusted context names that signer
forbiddenEffects: derive trusted authority from artifact signer

cases.name: retained-nonce-single-use
cases.purpose: The actual retained runtime accepts one presentation attempt and rejects reuse
forbiddenEffects: accept the same retained challenge twice

cases.name: wrong-domain-separator
cases.purpose: Correct artifact hash signed under another separator does not authenticate as VerifyResult

cases.name: raw-digest-preimage
cases.purpose: Signing separator plus raw digest bytes is rejected because §7.5 requires separator plus ASCII hexadecimal hash

cases.name: signature-algorithm-mutation
cases.purpose: Changing only the algorithm label preserves content identity but fails strict signature admission

cases.name: full-signed-object-hash-mutant
cases.purpose: Deliberate historical-defect mutant hashes the signature and must be detected by EVAL-002
